test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

Were the examination papers being checked by the teachers until late at night?

options.text: Are the teachers checking the examination papers until late at night?
Were the teachers checking the examination papers until late at night?
Did the teachers check the examination papers until late at night?
Have the teachers checked the examination papers until late at night?

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Were the teachers checking the examination papers until late at night?.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**, as indicated by the use of "Were" and "being checked."
 
• To convert it into the **active voice**, the subject (teachers) becomes the doer of the action, and the object (examination papers) is acted upon.
 
• The structure of the sentence in active voice is **Subject + was/were + verb (-ing) + object**.
 
• Thus, the correct active voice sentence is **"Were the teachers checking the examination papers until late at night?"**.

Correct sentence: *Were the teachers checking the examination papers until late at night?*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active and Passive Voice:**

 
 
• **Active Voice:** The subject performs the action. (e.g., The teacher checked the papers.)
 
• **Passive Voice:** The subject receives the action. (e.g., The papers were checked by the teacher.)
 
 
 
• **Key Steps to Convert Passive to Active Voice:**
 
 
• Identify the subject, verb, and object in the passive sentence.
 
• Rearrange the sentence so that the subject performs the action.
 
• Ensure the verb agrees with the subject.
